assertion.text: Erdős Problem #949: declared status 'open'. Formalized: yes. Let $S\subset \mathbb{R}$ be a set containing no solutions to $a+b=c$. Must there be a set $A\subseteq \mathbb{R}\backslash S$ of cardinality continuum such that $A+A\subseteq \mathbb{R}\backslash S$? Prize: no. Tags: ramsey theory.
